title: Optical-beams-MEEP Gaussian beam reflection and refraction

cases.behavior: central incidence exceeds critical angle; reflected beam and near-interface field

wavefront_quantity: Original final instantaneous Ez(t), shared signed scale
mean_squared_field_quantity: abs(monochromatic Ez phasor)^2/2 fitted over final two periods, shared linear scale
original_e2_s_quantity: Real instantaneous Ez(t)^2; not cycle mean
limitations: No mesh or PML convergence sweep
Finite beam has an angular spectrum; no exact zero-transmission claim
No measured R/T efficiency, flux monitor or incident-only subtraction
Length a has no fixed physical mapping
Phase-gradient angle is a local diagnostic
